scope: Non-operational computational analysis of de-identified public longitudinal SARS-CoV-2 viral-load measurements. No pathogen engineering, wet-lab protocol, clinical recommendation, or treatment claim.

origin_and_independence.C034_result_known_at_freeze: C034 could not score its frozen primary gate because only 8 participants met its minimum eligibility of 10; no C034 cohort-level loop direction or p-value was used to tune C035.
origin_and_independence.independent_target: A separate 2026 prospective case-control cohort with daily paired upper-respiratory sampling from incident naturally acquired infections.
origin_and_independence.no_retuning: C035 copies the substantive C034 thresholds unchanged.

target.dataset_title: Early Mucosal Type II Interferon Limits SARS-CoV-2 Replication in Humans
target.public_design_known_before_freeze: 16 incident SARS-CoV-2 cases with daily or twice-daily paired oral cavity, nasal cavity, and oropharyngeal samples; participant-level workbook values and sheet schemas have not been inspected in this C035 pass.

primary_pair.x_axis: nasal-cavity SARS-CoV-2 viral load on log10 scale
primary_pair.y_axis: oral-cavity SARS-CoV-2 viral load on log10 scale
primary_pair.prediction: chronological nasal-vs-oral trajectories form a predominantly clockwise loop (negative signed area with x=nasal,y=oral), consistent with oral-state lead relative to nasal-state progression
primary_pair.anti_cherry_pick: oropharynx may not replace oral cavity if the primary oral-nasal pair fails

observable.signed_loop_area: A_i=0.5*sum_j(x_j*y_{j+1}-x_{j+1}*y_j), closing the chronological paired-visit polyline from last to first
observable.reverse_identity: Reversing the identical chronological sequence flips the sign exactly; translating either assay/site coordinate by a constant leaves area unchanged.

eligibility.nonquantifiable_or_missing: exclude the paired visit; do not substitute an exact detection-limit value
eligibility.duplicate_subject_time: conflicting duplicate subject-time records are ambiguous and excluded rather than averaged
eligibility.controls: uninfected matched controls are not included in the primary loop-sign test because they are expected to lack sufficient viral-load dynamic range; their failure to meet eligibility is not a positive result

frozen_primary_gate.sign_test: two-sided exact sign test across eligible infected subjects, p<=0.01 and negative signs predominate
frozen_primary_gate.chronology_null: 10,000 deterministic within-subject chronology permutations, seed 35035; statistic=cohort median normalized signed area; one-sided p=(1+count(null_median<=observed_median))/10001 <=0.01
frozen_primary_gate.PASS: all: eligible subjects>=10; median area<=-0.10; exact sign p<=0.01 in predicted negative direction; chronology permutation p<=0.01
frozen_primary_gate.FAIL: median area>=0, robust opposite sign at p<=0.01, or either null p>0.05

pre_frozen_secondary.role: cross-site robustness within the same cohort only; cannot substitute for primary oral-nasal PASS and is not independent replication

if_PASS_next_gates: post-result exact prior-art killer search for within-host multi-site viral-load signed loop area/hysteresis/path-dependent mapping
material consequence test: compare static cross-site mapping versus orientation/phase-aware representation on held-out successor prediction
independent third dataset or second virus if claiming generality
